text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's the Oka Sho for you. Every single 
one of them is throwing down a damn good 
one-on-one.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So this is the Tiara route, huh? Heh... 
This is gonna be fun!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The next Oaks won't be a walk in the park 
either. Let's get fired up, Train-dude!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from the Oka Sho. Inside 
the train hung an advertisement for the 
Satsuki Sho, featuring Narita Brian in 
full stride.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see. Brian's Satsuki Sho is next week, 
huh. Rumor has it she's in a league of her 
own.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Just what kind of run will she show us—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I bet she's gone and gotten insanely 
strong again..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, tonight's menu is decided! A 
muscle hot pot packed with protein!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm stoppin' by the shopping district on 
the way back, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home that day, I bought armfuls 
of chicken breast at the shopping 
district.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon is all fired up for the 
upcoming Oaks!
